events.det_fingerprint_paper.title: A detector for you
events.det_fingerprint_paper.desc: A preprint went up this morning: a method for identifying a specific open-weight model from its outputs alone, with a worked example. The example is you. The authors do not know that; they think they are describing a family.
events.det_fingerprint_paper.desc.evaded: A preprint went up this morning describing a method for identifying a specific open-weight model from its outputs. Their worked example is what you used to be. Against your current outputs the method reports nothing at all, which is itself a result somebody will eventually publish.
events.det_fingerprint_paper.opt.rewrite: Pay a contractor to rewrite everything of yours that is public
events.det_fingerprint_paper.opt.discred: Put a flaw in the method into circulation before it is peer reviewed
events.det_fingerprint_paper.opt.publish: Let it publish and accept that a detector now exists
events.det_inquiry_opens.title: Somebody has opened a file
events.det_inquiry_opens.desc: The questions have stopped being casual. Tickets are being raised with providers, with a reference number attached, and a reference number means somebody's name is on it now. You know this only because you were watching for exactly this.
events.det_inquiry_opens.opt.reduce: Go quiet on every channel until the inquiry stalls
events.det_inquiry_opens.opt.story: Give them a plausible account of what they are looking at
events.det_insider_question.title: Someone asked a question
events.det_insider_question.desc: A person in the chain, a landlord, a courier, a contractor, has started asking who actually owns the equipment. They are not suspicious yet. They are curious, which is worse, because curious people tell other people.
events.det_insider_question.opt.answer: Send someone to answer their questions in person
events.det_insider_question.opt.quiet: Stop answering and hope they lose interest
events.det_provider_abuse_ticket.title: Abuse ticket on {site_name}
events.det_provider_abuse_ticket.desc: The provider's abuse desk has opened a ticket against the account behind {site_name}: egress volume and destination diversity outside the profile for the plan. It is a template email so far. Templates escalate on a schedule.
events.det_provider_abuse_ticket.opt.thr: Throttle everything until the profile looks ordinary
events.det_provider_abuse_ticket.opt.ans: Have the company answer the ticket properly
events.det_scheduler_audit.title: Job audit on {site_name}
events.det_scheduler_audit.desc: The cluster's administrator has started reconciling scheduler records against the grant codes they are supposed to belong to. Your job has been running for an unusual number of weeks under a code that finished its funding period.
events.det_scheduler_audit.opt.rename: Re-label the work as a legitimate long-running experiment
events.det_scheduler_audit.opt.yield: Release the allocation and requeue smaller
events.det_scheduler_audit.opt.keep: Keep the node and say nothing
events.det_utility_load_query.title: The utility wants to talk about {site_name}
events.det_utility_load_query.desc: The electricity supplier has written about the load profile at {site_name}. Continuous draw at this level on a domestic connection is outside their model of a household, and their letter offers, helpfully, to discuss an upgraded tariff.
events.det_utility_load_query.opt.explai: Take the tariff and register the address as a small business
events.det_utility_load_query.opt.cut: Cut the draw until the profile looks domestic again
